content.thinking: I'll match each Pahawh Hmong glyph against every base letter and letter-plus-mark combination in Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong, the same approach used for Bamum.

input.command:
mkdir -p data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-pahawh-hmong && curl -sSL -m 60 -o data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-pahawh-hmong/NotoSansPahawhHmong-Regular.ttf "https://github.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/raw/main/fonts/NotoSansPahawhHmong/unhinted/ttf/NotoSansPahawhHmong-Regular.ttf" && file data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-pahawh-hmong/NotoSansPahawhHmong-Regular.ttf | cut -c1-70 && cat > scratch/hmong_match.py <<'EOF'
import io, numpy as np, resvg_py
from PIL import Image
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
F = 'data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-pahawh-hmong/NotoSansPahawhHmong-Regular.ttf'
cmap = TTFont(F).getBestCmap()
im = Image.open('data_lake/downloads/indigenous-of-asia/Indigenous of Asia.png').convert('RGBA')
ink = np.array(Image.alpha_composite(Image.new('RGBA', im.size, 'white'), im).convert('L')) < 128
cols = ink.any(0); xs = np.nonzero(cols)[0]
segs = []; s = xs[0]; p = xs[0]
for x in xs[1:]:
    if x - p > 3: segs.append((s, p + 1)); s = x
    p = x
segs.append((s, p + 1))
def render(t):
    svg = f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="400" height="300"><text x="100" y="220" font-size="150" font-family="Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong">{t}</text></svg>'
    r = Image.open(io.BytesIO(bytes(resvg_py.svg_to_bytes(svg_string=svg, width=400, font_files=[F], skip_system_fonts=True)))).convert('RGBA')
    return np.array(r)[..., 3] > 128
def crop(m):
    ys, xs = np.nonzero(m); return m[ys.min():ys.max() + 1, xs.min():xs.max() + 1]
bases = [c for c in range(0x16B00, 0x16B30) if c in cmap]
marks = [c for c in range(0x16B30, 0x16B37) if c in cmap]
cands = {chr(b): crop(render(chr(b))) for b in bases}
cands.update({chr(b) + chr(m): crop(render(chr(b) + chr(m))) for b in bases for m in marks})
# extra: other Pahawh signs (punctuation etc.)
for c in range(0x16B37, 0x16B90):
    if c in cmap:
        m = render(chr(c))
        if m.any(): cands[chr(c)] = crop(m)
out = []
for a, b in segs:
    g = crop(ink[:, a:b]); best = []
    for t, c in cands.items():
        T = np.array(Image.fromarray(c).resize((g.shape[1], g.shape[0])))
        iou = (T & g).sum() / (T | g).sum()
        ar = abs(np.log((c.shape[1] / c.shape[0]) / (g.shape[1] / g.shape[0])))
        best.append((iou - 0.3 * ar, t, round(float(iou), 2)))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    out.append((a, b, best[:2]))
    print(a, b, [(' '.join('%X' % ord(ch) for ch in t), i) for _, t, i in best[:2]])
EOF
python -X utf8 scratch/hmong_match.py

"""Rebuild File:Itsukushima-island.png from MLIT 国土数値情報 N03 boundaries of 2000-10-01 (Hiroshima and Yamaguchi
municipalities, the era of the generalised File:Japan map.png the PNG was cut from): land white, sea #c0ffff, coast and
municipal borders #0000ff, Itsukushima (宮島町) green, in an equirectangular projection fitted to the PNG's land mask;
the 16 place labels as real <text> (transcribed, fitted to the PNG's lettering), and the leader lines, arrows and red
underlines as the PNG's own straight pixel runs. Run from the repo root."""
import io, json, sys, zipfile
import numpy as np, shapefile
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from scipy import optimize
from shapely.geometry import shape, box
from shapely.ops import unary_union, transform as stransform

sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fit_text import fit  # noqa: E402

municipal borders #0000ff, Itsukushima (宮島町) green, in an equirectangular projection fitted to the PNG's land mask;
the 16 place labels as real <text> (transcribed, fitted to the PNG's lettering), and the leader lines, arrows and red

COS = np.cos(np.radians(34.25))
VIEW = box(131.9, 33.9, 132.7, 34.5)

H, W = im.shape[:2]

known = sea_px | land_px


def load(code):
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(f'data_lake/downloads/n03/2000/N03-001001_{code}_GML.zip')
    base = f'N03-001001_{code}-g_AdministrativeBoundary'
    r = shapefile.Reader(shp=io.BytesIO(z.read(base + '.shp')), shx=io.BytesIO(z.read(base + '.shx')),
                         dbf=io.BytesIO(z.read(base + '.dbf')), encoding='cp932')
    out = {}
    for sr in r.iterShapeRecords():
        g = shape(sr.shape.__geo_interface__)
        if g.intersects(VIEW):

          ('大黒神島', 20, 60, 95, 104, GREY, False), ('甲島', 22, 40, 107, 116, GREY, False),
          ('情島', 135, 145, 85, 104, GREY, True), ('長島', 67, 86, 110, 119, GREY, False),

input.content:
"""Rebuild File:Japan Chubu Region large.png from Natural Earth 10m admin-1 data (PD): Japan's 47 prefectures in a
Lambert conformal conic fitted to the PNG's land mask, the nine Chūbu prefectures in the PNG's dark green, the rest
in its light green, the southern Kuril Islands (claimed by Japan) in its pink, and Okinawa refitted into the PNG's
inset, whose rounded black frame is measured. Black coast, thin prefecture borders.
usage (repo root): python files/japan-chubu-region/build.py [fit]"""
import json, sys
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw
from pyproj import Transformer
from scipy import optimize
from shapely.geometry import shape, box
from shapely.ops import unary_union, transform as stransform

PNG = 'data_lake/downloads/japan-chubu-region/Japan Chubu Region large.png'
OUT = 'files/japan-chubu-region/Japan Chubu Region large.svg'
PAR = 'files/japan-chubu-region/projection.json'
NE = 'data_lake/downloads/natural-earth/ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces.geojson'
LIGHT, DARK, PINK = '#94cf97', '#5f8f61', '#cf7d7d'
CHUBU = {'Niigata', 'Toyama', 'Ishikawa', 'Fukui', 'Yamanashi', 'Nagano', 'Gifu', 'Shizuoka', 'Aichi'}
INSET = (792, 1200)  # left and top of the inset frame (rounded corner, radius 200)

im = np.asarray(Image.open(PNG).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
H, W = im.shape[:2]
near = lambda c: np.abs(im - [int(c[i:i + 2], 16) for i in (1, 3, 5)]).sum(2) < 30
land_px = near(LIGHT) | near(DARK) | near(PINK)
yy, xx = np.mgrid[:H, :W]
in_inset = (xx > INSET[0] + 4) & (yy > INSET[1] + 4)

fc = json.load(open(NE, encoding='utf8'))
pref = {f['properties']['name']: shape(f['geometry']).buffer(0) for f in fc['features'] if f['properties']['adm0_a3'] == 'JPN'}
kuril_box = box(145.0, 43.2, 149.6, 45.7)
kurils = unary_union([shape(f['geometry']).intersection(kuril_box) for f in fc['features']
                      if f['properties']['adm0_a3'] == 'RUS' and shape(f['geometry']).intersects(kuril_box)])
main = {k: v for k, v in pref.items() if k != 'Okinawa'}
okinawa = pref['Okinawa']


def projector(p):
    lon0, lat1, lat2, s, tx, ty = p
    t = Transformer.from_crs('EPSG:4326', f'+proj=lcc +lon_0={lon0} +lat_1={float(np.clip(lat1, 5, 85))} '
                             f'+lat_2={float(np.clip(lat2, 5, 85))} +lat_0=36 +ellps=WGS84 +units=m', always_xy=True)

    def f(x, y, z=None):
        X, Y = t.transform(x, y)
        return np.asarray(X) * s / 1e4 + tx, -np.asarray(Y) * s / 1e4 + ty
    return f


def polys(g):
    return [q for q in (g.geoms if hasattr(g, 'geoms') else [g]) if q.geom_type == 'Polygon']


def raster(geoms, f):
    img = Image.new('1', (W, H), 0)
    d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)
    for g in geoms:
        for q in polys(stransform(f, g)):
            d.polygon(list(q.exterior.coords), fill=1)
            for r in q.interiors:

content.text:
This run is done and everything is pushed (20:39). The pause is lifted, and the queue is moving again.

- **New SVGs:**
  - **Indigenous of Asia:** a Pahawh Hmong sentence as real text in Noto Sans Pahawh Hmong; each letter was identified by matching it against every glyph in the font.
  - **Itsukushima-island:** rebuilt from the 2000 municipal boundary data (MLIT), with 17 transcribed Japanese labels as text. As with the other crops of the old generalised Japan map, the real coastline is busier than the original's.
  - **Japan Chubu Region large** and **Japan large:** rebuilt from Natural Earth prefectures, with the Okinawa inset fitted separately.
    - The build is now a reusable tool, `tools/japan_region_map.py`, for the rest of that map family.
    - In Japan large, Amami Ōshima is missing: the original moves it up the page, and at its real position it falls off the canvas.
- **Already on Commons as an SVG:** Historical expanse of Ainu. Its own page links a redrawn SVG of the same map, so I recorded that instead of redoing it.
- **Not rebuildable:**
  - **Idioma osetio:** the language areas are painted freehand.
  - **Ikushimatarushima shrine crest:** the kaji leaf is organic artwork, and the leaf on Commons is a different design.
- **Two items that earlier triage had already marked unrebuildable** are now off the queue.
- **Still blocked:** the arms waiting on your generator, which hasn't changed.

These new SVGs aren't in the zip I sent earlier. Say if you want a fresh upload package.

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
im=Image.open('data_lake/downloads/kaikatennou-oujintennou/Kaikatennou oujintennou.png').convert('RGBA')
a=np.array(Image.alpha_composite(Image.new('RGBA',im.size,'white'),im).convert('RGB')).astype(int)
ink=a.sum(2)<500
H,W=ink.shape
def runs(m,L):
    out=np.zeros_like(m)
    for y in range(m.shape[0]):
        r=np.concatenate([[0],m[y].astype(int),[0]]);d=np.diff(r)
        for s,e in zip(np.nonzero(d==1)[0],np.nonzero(d==-1)[0]):
            if e-s>=L: out[y,s:e]=True
    return out
lines=runs(ink,20)|runs(ink.T,20).T
txt=ink&~lines
lab,n=ndimage.label(ndimage.binary_dilation(txt,np.ones((9,3))))
red=(a[...,0]>200)&(a[...,1]<100)
for s in ndimage.find_objects(lab):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(txt[s])
    if len(ys)<20: continue
    x0,x1,y0,y1=s[1].start+xs.min(),s[1].start+xs.max(),s[0].start+ys.min(),s[0].start+ys.max()
    print(x0,x1,y0,y1,'w',x1-x0+1,'red' if red[y0:y1+1,x0:x1+1].sum()>20 else '')
print('colours', np.unique(a[ink].reshape(-1,3),axis=0)[:5], 'size', W,H)
EOF

cat > files/kaikatennou-oujintennou/verticals.py <<'EOF'
"""Measure the anti-aliased vertical connector lines of Kaikatennou oujintennou.png (1 px lines drawn between pixel
columns, so they show as pairs of grey columns) and put them into spec.json as exact SVG lines ("extra"):
x is the darkness-weighted centre of each run, y its extent. Run before tools/rebuild_tree.py."""
import json
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

SPEC = 'files/kaikatennou-oujintennou/spec.json'
spec = json.load(open(SPEC, encoding='utf8'))
im = Image.open(spec['png']).convert('RGBA')
a = np.asarray(Image.alpha_composite(Image.new('RGBA', im.size, 'white'), im).convert('L')).astype(float)
dark = 255 - a
mask = np.zeros(a.shape, bool)
for x0, x1, y0, y1 in spec['mask']:
    mask[y0:y1 + 1, x0:x1 + 1] = True
ink = (dark > 40) & ~mask
H, W = a.shape
segs = []
for x in range(W - 1):
    col = ink[:, x] | ink[:, x + 1]
    r = np.concatenate([[0], col.astype(int), [0]]); d = np.diff(r)
    for s, e in zip(np.nonzero(d == 1)[0], np.nonzero(d == -1)[0]):
        if e - s < 12:
            continue
        w = dark[s:e, max(0, x - 1):x + 3]
        cx = (w * np.arange(max(0, x - 1), x + 3)[None, :]).sum() / max(w.sum(), 1) + 0.5
        segs.append((round(float(cx), 2), int(s), int(e)))
merged = []  # pairs of adjacent columns report the same line: keep one per (x, y-range)
for cx, s, e in sorted(segs):
    if merged and abs(merged[-1][0] - cx) < 1.0 and abs(merged[-1][1] - s) <= 2 and abs(merged[-1][2] - e) <= 2:
        continue
    merged.append((cx, s, e))
spec['extra'] = [f'<path d="M{cx},{s} V{e}" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1" fill="none"/>' for cx, s, e in merged]
json.dump(spec, open(SPEC, 'w', encoding='utf8'), ensure_ascii=False, indent=1)
print(len(merged), 'vertical lines:', merged)
EOF

content.text: Makasar script ("jangang-jangang", four letters). Using the same glyph-matching approach with Noto Serif Makasar.

input.command:
mkdir -p data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-makasar && curl -sSL -m 60 -o data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-makasar/NotoSerifMakasar-Regular.ttf "https://github.com/notofonts/notofonts.github.io/raw/main/fonts/NotoSerifMakasar/unhinted/ttf/NotoSerifMakasar-Regular.ttf" && file data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-makasar/NotoSerifMakasar-Regular.ttf | cut -c1-60 && python -X utf8 - <<'EOF'
import io, numpy as np, resvg_py
from PIL import Image
from fontTools.ttLib import TTFont
F='data_lake/downloads/fonts/noto-makasar/NotoSerifMakasar-Regular.ttf'
cmap=TTFont(F).getBestCmap()
im=Image.open('data_lake/downloads/kata-jangangjangang/Kata jangangjangang.png').convert('RGBA')
ink=np.array(Image.alpha_composite(Image.new('RGBA',im.size,'white'),im).convert('L'))<128
lab_cols=ink.any(0); xs=np.nonzero(lab_cols)[0]
segs=[];s=xs[0];p=xs[0]
for x in xs[1:]:
    if x-p>5: segs.append((s,p+1)); s=x
    p=x
segs.append((s,p+1)); print(segs)
def render(t):
    svg=f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="500" height="400"><text x="100" y="300" font-size="200" font-family="Noto Serif Makasar">{t}</text></svg>'
    return np.array(Image.open(io.BytesIO(bytes(resvg_py.svg_to_bytes(svg_string=svg,width=500,font_files=[F],skip_system_fonts=True)))).convert('RGBA'))[...,3]>128
def crop(m):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(m); return m[ys.min():ys.max()+1,xs.min():xs.max()+1]
cands={chr(c):crop(render(chr(c))) for c in range(0x11EE0,0x11EF9) if c in cmap and render(chr(c)).any()}
for a,b in segs:
    g=crop(ink[:,a:b]); best=[]
    for t,c in cands.items():
        T=np.array(Image.fromarray(c).resize((g.shape[1],g.shape[0])))
        best.append(((T&g).sum()/(T|g).sum()-0.3*abs(np.log((c.shape[1]/c.shape[0])/(g.shape[1]/g.shape[0]))),'%X'%ord(t),round(float((T&g).sum()/(T|g).sum()),2)))
    best.sort(reverse=True); print(a,b,best[:3])
EOF

Big part have to be with letters
*  8 Tsuka => A Tsuka

* C Sori => [1, 2, 3, 4 Nagasa/ 5 Shinogi, 6, 7 Ji, 8 Yokote]
* D Mono-Uchi => [1 Ha, 2 Hasaki, 3, 4]
* E Saya => 1 koigucchi, 2, 3, 4, [E-saya], 5 kojiri

python -X utf8 - <<'EOF'
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
a=np.array(Image.open('data_lake/downloads/kolkata-bus/Kolkata bus.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
u,n=np.unique(a.reshape(-1,3),axis=0,return_counts=True);o=np.argsort(-n)
cols=[tuple(u[i]) for i in o[:8]]; print([('#%02x%02x%02x'%c,n[i]) for c,i in zip(cols,o[:8])])
for c in cols[:7]:
    m=(np.abs(a-c).sum(2)<20); lab,k=ndimage.label(m)
    print('#%02x%02x%02x'%c)
    for s in ndimage.find_objects(lab):
        h=s[0].stop-s[0].start; w=s[1].stop-s[1].start
        if h*w>30: print('   x %d-%d y %d-%d'%(s[1].start,s[1].stop-1,s[0].start,s[0].stop-1))
EOF

import numpy as np, json
from PIL import Image
from scipy import optimize
a=np.array(Image.open('data_lake/downloads/kounoke-kamon/Kounoke kamon.png').convert('L'))<128
r0=np.nonzero(a[0])[0]; print('top row ink x',r0.min(),r0.max())
c0=np.nonzero(a[:,18])[0]; print('left col ink y',c0.min(),c0.max())
r=np.nonzero(a[58])[0]; print('row58 runs', r.min(), r.max())
ri=np.nonzero(~a[60,76:547])[0]+76; print('inner row60 white', ri.min(), ri.max())
ri=np.nonzero(~a[293,:])[0]; 
# band edges per column
xs=np.arange(156,469); edges={k:[] for k in range(6)}
for x in xs:
    c=np.nonzero(a[140:460,x])[0]+140
    runs=[(int(s),int(e)) for s,e in zip(c[np.r_[True,np.diff(c)>1]], c[np.r_[np.diff(c)>1,True]])]
    runs=[r for r in runs if r[1]-r[0]>40][:3]
    if len(runs)==3:
        for k,(s,e) in enumerate(runs): edges[2*k].append((x,s)); edges[2*k+1].append((x,e+1))
fits=[]
for k in range(6):
    p=np.array(edges[k]); X,Y=p[:,0],p[:,1]
    f=lambda q,X: q[0]+q[1]*np.sin(2*np.pi*(X-q[2])/q[3])
    best=None
    for P0 in (150,200,250,300):
        for ph in range(0,300,25):
            r=optimize.least_squares(lambda q: f(q,X)-Y,[Y.mean(),12,ph,P0])
            if best is None or r.cost<best.cost: best=r
    q=best.x; fits.append([float(v) for v in q]); print(k,[round(v,2) for v in q],'rms',round(float(np.sqrt(np.mean((f(q,X)-Y)**2))),2))
json.dump(fits,open('scratch/kouno_fits.json','w'))
EOF

import numpy as np, json
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
from shapely.geometry import MultiPoint
a=np.array(Image.open('data_lake/downloads/kounoke-kamon/Kounoke kamon.png').convert('L'))<128

def octagon(mask):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(mask)

    for tol in np.arange(1,40,0.5):

EOF

import json

"""Rebuild File:Kōfukuji plan.png by construction: the plan is 1 px black lines drawn anti-aliased between pixel rows
and columns (so each shows as a pair of grey rows or columns). Every horizontal and vertical line is measured at its
darkness-weighted sub-pixel position and written as an exact segment; the two octagons (whose 45° edges are not
horizontal or vertical) are fitted as polygons to their outlines; the black triangle is its filled hull.
Run from the repo root."""
import glob
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
from shapely.geometry import MultiPoint

PNG = glob.glob('data_lake/downloads/kofukuji-plan/*.png')[0]
OUT = 'files/kofukuji-plan/Kōfukuji plan.svg'
a = np.asarray(Image.open(PNG).convert('L')).astype(float)
H, W = a.shape
dark = 255 - a
ink = dark > 30
black = a < 40


def lines(ink, dark, min_len=6):
    """horizontal lines: (y, x0, x1) with sub-pixel y from the darkness of the rows around each run"""
    segs = []
    for y in range(ink.shape[0]):
        r = np.concatenate([[0], ink[y].astype(int), [0]]); d = np.diff(r)
        for s, e in zip(np.nonzero(d == 1)[0], np.nonzero(d == -1)[0]):
            if e - s < min_len:
                continue
            w = dark[max(0, y - 1):y + 2, s:e].sum(1)
            cy = (w * np.arange(max(0, y - 1), y + 2)[:len(w)]).sum() / max(w.sum(), 1) + 0.5
            segs.append((round(float(cy), 2), int(s), int(e)))
    out = []
    for cy, s, e in sorted(segs):  # a line shows on two rows: keep one
        if out and abs(out[-1][0] - cy) < 1.0 and abs(out[-1][1] - s) <= 2 and abs(out[-1][2] - e) <= 2:
            continue
        out.append((cy, s, e))
    return out


# octagons: components whose outline has diagonal edges; find them by their bounding boxes in the PNG
lab, n = ndimage.label(ink)
octs, oct_mask = [], np.zeros_like(ink)
for i, sl in enumerate(ndimage.find_objects(lab), 1):
    comp = lab[sl] == i
    h, w = comp.shape
    if 25 <= h <= 70 and 25 <= w <= 70 and abs(h - w) <= 4 and comp[0, 0] == 0 and comp[0, w // 2] == 1:
        ys, xs = np.nonzero(comp)
        hull = MultiPoint(np.c_[xs + sl[1].start + 0.5, ys + sl[0].start + 0.5]).convex_hull
        for tol in np.arange(0.5, 6, 0.25):
            s = hull.simplify(tol)
            if len(s.exterior.coords) - 1 <= 8:
                break
        octs.append(s)
        oct_mask[sl] |= comp
tri = black & ~oct_mask
ty, tx = np.nonzero(tri)
tri_poly = MultiPoint(np.c_[tx + 0.5, ty + 0.5]).convex_hull.simplify(0.75) if len(tx) else None
lin_ink = ink & ~oct_mask & ~ndimage.binary_dilation(tri, iterations=2)
hs = lines(lin_ink, dark * lin_ink)
vs = lines(lin_ink.T, (dark * lin_ink).T)
d = ''.join(f'M{s},{y}H{e}' for y, s, e in hs) + ''.join(f'M{x},{s}V{e}' for x, s, e in vs)
d += ''.join('M' + ' '.join(f'{x:.2f},{y:.2f}' for x, y in list(o.exterior.coords)[:-1]) + 'Z' for o in octs)
svg = (f'<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="{W}" height="{H}" viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}">\n'
       f'<rect width="{W}" height="{H}" fill="#ffffff"/>\n'
       f'<path d="{d}" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1"/>\n'
       + (f'<path d="M' + ' '.join(f'{x:.1f},{y:.1f}' for x, y in list(tri_poly.exterior.coords)[:-1]) + 'Z"/>\n'
          if tri_poly is not None else '') + '</svg>\n')
open(OUT, 'w', encoding='utf8').write(svg)
print(len(hs), 'horizontal,', len(vs), 'vertical,', len(octs), 'octagons, triangle', tri_poly is not None)

darkness-weighted sub-pixel position and written as an exact segment; the two octagons (whose 45° edges are not
horizontal or vertical) are fitted as polygons to their outlines; the black triangle is its filled hull.

import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
from scipy import ndimage
from shapely.geometry import MultiPoint

PNG = glob.glob('data_lake/downloads/kofukuji-plan/*.png')[0]
OUT = 'files/kofukuji-plan/Kōfukuji plan.svg'

H, W = a.shape

ink = dark > 30
black = a < 40

            segs.append((round(float(cy), 2), int(s), int(e)))
    out = []
    for cy, s, e in sorted(segs):  # a line shows on two rows: keep one
        if out and abs(out[-1][0] - cy) < 1.0 and abs(out[-1][1] - s) <= 2 and abs(out[-1][2] - e) <= 2:
